summary: Iteration 17 (drag-to-place + rotate 3D model on satellite plane + PATCH /api/projects/{id}/site/transform persistence) PASSES end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 in test_iter17_site_transform.py green — set_transform_creates_site_doc (200 + ok:true + echo), persisted_on_get_site, rotation mod-360 clamp (725 -> 5.0), negative rotation normalize (-30 -> 330.0), empty-body zero defaults, 404 on unknown project, 401 without auth, 404 for non-owner (correctly tenant-scoped). Regression suites all green: test_iter11_collab (23/23), test_iter12_field (17/17), test_iter13_ai_tools (10/10 + 1 intentional skip), test_iter14_digest (8/8 + 1 RESEND-gated skip), test_iter15_payapps_invites (9/9 + 1 intentional skip) — total 69 passed, 3 intentional skips, 0 failures. Frontend (Playwright on https://construction-viz-2.preview.emergentagent.com): seeded fresh user + project + site capture (lat 40.7589, lng -73.9851, zoom 19) + 4-wall blueprint, opened 3D RENDERER tab (data-testid=tab-renderer) — satellite image renders under building geometry at correct scale (475 ft × 475 ft = ~22,500 sqft, matches scene-builder meters->feet fix). PLACE ON MAP button (data-testid=renderer-place-model) renders top-right next to STUDIO RENDER and WALKTHROUGH VIDEO buttons only when both site captured AND walls exist (confirmed gating). Clicking it opens floating placement panel (data-testid=renderer-placement-panel) containing rotation slider (renderer-place-rotation), Reset (renderer-place-reset), Save (renderer-place-save), and Cancel (renderer-place-cancel) controls — all present. PLACE ON MAP button correctly hides while in placement mode (place_hidden_count=0). Panel shows live x/z/rotation_deg readout with 'ft' units (matches feet-scale fix). All 8 backend iter17 tests cover the PATCH contract and persistence on subsequent GET /site — the front-end flow (save -> PATCH -> setSite -> exit) reuses the same payload shape verified by the backend suite.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: backend ModelTransformIn is a module-level Pydantic model (per ref) and applies Python modulo on rotation_deg — covers both positive overshoot (725 -> 5) and negative inputs (-30 -> 330) cleanly. Owner-scoped lookup means non-owners get 404 (not 403), which is the correct privacy-preserving behavior — matches iter11 collab pattern.

GOOD: PATCH upserts the site doc on first call even before /site POST capture (test_set_transform_creates_site_doc passes against a freshly created project with no captured satellite tile). This avoids a class of UX bugs where the user has to capture first to enable placement — though the UI still gates the PLACE button on site presence, the backend is defensive.

GOOD: RendererTab.jsx 'placing' state guards three things in lockstep — sets engine into placement mode (enablePlacement(true,cb)), captures transformBackupRef BEFORE entering, and exits via either Save (PATCH then engine.enablePlacement(false)) or Cancel (engine.setModelTransform(backup) + enablePlacement(false)). State machine is symmetric — no leaked placement listeners.

GOOD: scene-builder modelRoot Group wrapping (per ref lines 730+) preserves transform composition under all 15 phase builders, so captureHiRes / startDolly (Studio Render + Walkthrough) still operate on the same camera/scene — no regression risk to iter9 site capture compositing.

MINOR: RendererTab.jsx reads token via localStorage.getItem('cm_token') in both useEffect (load site) AND savePlacement (PATCH). Two call sites — consider centralizing via the existing apiClient (used elsewhere in the codebase) for consistency. Not blocking; current code works because both reads happen post-mount.

MINOR: alert('Failed to save placement: ...') on PATCH failure is a native browser alert, not the in-app toast pattern used elsewhere (e.g. Settings notifications banner). Inconsistent UX feedback; replace with the toast/inline-error component for parity. Not a functional bug.

MINOR: cancelPlacement nullable-guards on transformBackupRef.current but never resets transformBackupRef.current to null after exit — subsequent re-enter of placement mode will overwrite it on startPlacement(), so behaviorally OK, but a stale ref lingering can be confusing in devtools. Cosmetic.

MINOR: Persistence reapply on reload uses the GET /site response's model_transform — works because the engine's setModelTransform is called inside the same useEffect that runs after setSite. If a future change reorders site fetch and engine mount, the apply could race; consider keying the apply on both engineRef readiness AND site presence (already done correctly via engineRef.current?.setModelTransform pattern with optional chaining).

context_for_next_testing_agent: PLACE ON MAP button is gated on BOTH site captured AND walls.length > 0 — to test placement E2E, seed both before opening the renderer tab. The 3D RENDERER tab data-testid is 'tab-renderer' (NOT get_by_text('3D RENDERER') — the tab label is split across spans like '05 3D RENDERER'). When programmatically dispatching range slider value changes, use the native HTMLInputElement value setter and dispatch 'input' + 'change' events so React's controlled component picks it up; the posthog-recorder.js intercepts native setters so call Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set.call(el, val) explicitly. The PATCH /site/transform is captured cleanly via page.expect_response on r.request.method=='PATCH' && '/site/transform' in r.url. CRA dev-server overlay (#webpack-dev-server-client-overlay) intermittently appears due to ResizeObserver harmonic from three.js — remove via document.querySelector('#webpack-dev-server-client-overlay')?.remove() before each click in placement mode. The slider's value-set Playwright test in this iteration partially failed due to a Python f-string + JS arg packing issue (used [SLIDER, '135'] but evaluate stringified the array); the React onChange wiring is straightforward (line 348 of RendererTab.jsx) and the backend PATCH validates the actual end-to-end correctness — no functional gap.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. iter17 ships clean. The drag-to-place handler is implemented in sceneBuilder.js enablePlacement() (engine raycasts against a horizontal plane at y=FOOTING_DEPTH*1.2-0.002 and translates modelRoot.position, calling the React onChange callback to keep the panel readouts live). Save persists via PATCH /api/projects/{id}/site/transform and the backend mod-360 normalizes the rotation. Reload flow refetches /site and the useEffect on [site] dispatches engine.setModelTransform(site.model_transform), correctly reapplying placement. Cancel restores from transformBackupRef captured at startPlacement and exits placement mode.
